highlights: Inspecting a domain with a space in it no longer closes the app.
Availability tells you when a name is actually free. It could previously only report Registered or Unknown, which is also why the alternative-domain suggestions never showed anything.
Redirect tracing follows plain http again, so a site that redirects to https is shown doing it.
Email alerts refuse to send your SMTP password over an unencrypted connection, and a domain can no longer slip extra headers into the message.
Turning on iCloud sync no longer clears the tags on your tracked domains.

Pro+ is shared portfolios, unlimited audit sessions, and the full intelligence breakdown. Ownership history and DNS history are free for everyone now, extended subdomain discovery moved to Pro, and the pricing and reputation entries are gone — they never returned data. The usage counters are gone too; nothing enforced them.
